title: 草船借箭
subtitle: 紙雕動態繪本 · Grok Image-to-Video
route: image-to-video (page-turn baked into the still's first frame)
style: a close-up photograph of a beautifully made Chinese pop-up storybook lying open on a dark walnut table, the open book filling the frame almost edge to edge with only a sliver of table showing; BOTH flat pages are fully printed with soft ink-wash scenery — indigo river, grey mist and distant mountains on a warm ivory paper ground, no blank paper anywhere — and from the centre fold a layered cut-paper diorama rises in three tiers with visible paper grain, torn deckle edges and real shadows falling between the layers; warm lamplight rakes in from the upper left against a cold blue night, shallow depth of field, crisp macro detail, real object photography, no text, no words, no letters, no watermark

They are flat hand-painted paper cut-outs on small paper tabs with visible paper grain and scissor edges; never realistic, never real people. ZHUGE LIANG: calm, gentle smile, pale cream Taoist robe, dark head-wrap, white feather fan. ZHOU YU: proud young general, dark lamellar armour, crimson sash, dark plume. LU SU: kindly round-faced official in a soft blue robe and black hat. CAO CAO: older warlord, heavy charcoal armour, red plume, short beard. Straw-boat soldiers: little straw-bundle figures with round straw heads under wide hats.

cover.text:
赤壁之前，江上大霧。
三日之內，十萬支箭——這是一樁不可能的軍令，也是一個早已想好的計策。

chapters.title: 周瑜的刁難
chapters.text:
赤壁大戰前，周瑜妒忌諸葛亮的才智，故意設下難題：「軍中缺箭，就請先生在十天內趕造十萬支箭吧。」
這分明是要陷害他。諸葛亮卻只是搖著羽扇，微微一笑。
chapters.prompt: inside a lamplit military tent painted on the backdrop, ZHOU YU standing stern with an angry frown, pointing sharply across a low table at ZHUGE LIANG, who stands calm with a gentle knowing smile, feather fan raised; a small paper lantern glows on the table

video.prompt: lantern flames flickering and casting shifting paper shadows across the tent, the general's sash stirring, the strategist calmly waving his feather fan, a thin curl of incense smoke rising
video.beat: a thin curl of incense smoke rises past the small paper lanterns

chapters.only: exactly TWO figures: Zhou Yu (dark plume) and Zhuge Liang; nobody else, no duplicates

chapters.title: 三日的軍令狀
chapters.text:
「十天太久，只要三天就夠了。」諸葛亮竟當眾立下軍令狀：若造不出箭，甘願受罰。
周瑜暗自得意，以為這回諸葛亮插翅難逃。
chapters.prompt: inside a lamplit army tent painted on the backdrop, ZHUGE LIANG with a calm gentle smile pressing a red seal onto a paper pledge on a low table, ZHOU YU standing behind with a smug self-satisfied smirk and one eyebrow raised, arms folded, LU SU at the side looking worried with raised eyebrows; a small paper lantern on the table

video.prompt: candle flames dancing, the paper pledge document trembling slightly as the seal presses down, the general's smug smile deepening, smoke and shadows shifting
video.beat: a candle flame wavers and the paper pledge trembles slightly

chapters.title: 向魯肅借船
chapters.text:
諸葛亮悄悄找來魯肅，借了二十艘快船，每船三十名軍士，船身兩側綁滿稻草人，再用青布幔子遮起來。
「千萬別告訴都督。」諸葛亮低聲叮嚀。
chapters.prompt: a misty empty night riverbank painted on the backdrop — just water, reeds and fog, with no boats and no people painted in it; on the near page stands a LONG WOODEN RIVERBOAT shown as a flat cut-paper side view, wide and low with a curved prow and stern and a rounded cloth canopy amidships, as long as three of the little figures standing side by side, cut from painted paper and standing upright on its own paper tab — it is a proper boat, NOT a folded origami paper boat and not a tiny toy; four straw-bundle soldier figures stand along it, and in front ZHUGE LIANG leans in with a secretive smile whispering to LU SU, who looks puzzled and curious; one small paper lantern on a pole

video.prompt: night fog drifting over the moored boats, cloth canopies rippling in the breeze, lantern light glinting on the water, the two figures leaning in to whisper, reeds swaying
video.beat: night fog drifts slowly over the moored paper boats

chapters.title: 按兵不動
chapters.text:
第一天，諸葛亮沒有動靜。第二天，還是沒有動靜。
魯肅急得團團轉，諸葛亮卻只是喝茶讀書，彷彿胸有成竹。
chapters.prompt: a quiet study at night painted on the backdrop, ZHUGE LIANG sitting relaxed with a serene smile sipping tea from a tiny cup, LU SU pacing beside him with an anxious frowning face and hands clasped; a small paper lantern glowing on a low table

chapters.title: 大霧漫江
chapters.text:
到了第三天四更，江上忽然起了漫天大霧，對面看不見人影。
諸葛亮請魯肅一同上船，二十艘船用長索連成一線，趁著濃霧向北岸曹營划去。
chapters.prompt: a wide river swallowed by thick fog before dawn painted on the backdrop, empty of people; on the near page one long paper boat carries exactly two seated figures — ZHUGE LIANG with a gentle smile and his feather fan, and LU SU beside him wide-eyed and nervous — with straw-bundle soldiers standing behind them; there is only ONE figure in a cream robe in the whole picture; one small paper lantern glows in the mist

chapters.title: 擂鼓吶喊
chapters.text:
船隊逼近曹營水寨，諸葛亮下令一字排開，軍士一齊擂鼓吶喊，聲勢震天。
魯肅嚇得臉色發白：「萬一曹兵殺出來怎麼辦？」諸葛亮大笑：「霧這麼大，曹操必不敢出。」
chapters.prompt: a towering fortress dim in the fog painted on the backdrop, straw-bundle soldiers beating little paper war drums with open mouths, ZHUGE LIANG laughing cheerfully with his fan raised, LU SU beside him looking terrified with round shocked eyes; a small paper lantern swinging

chapters.title: 萬箭齊發
chapters.text:
曹操聽見鼓聲，怕有埋伏，不敢出戰，只命一萬多名弓箭手朝江面猛射。
箭如飛蝗，密密麻麻地插滿了草人和船身。諸葛亮又下令調頭，讓另一side也受滿了箭。
chapters.prompt: a tall wooden watchtower and fog painted on the backdrop, CAO CAO standing on the tower with an angry frown pointing forward to order the volley, a dense rain of little paper arrows streaking down and sticking into straw-bundle soldiers on a paper boat below

chapters.title: 滿載而歸
chapters.text:
天快亮時，霧漸漸散去，二十艘船上插滿了箭，足足超過十萬支。
軍士齊聲高喊：「謝丞相賜箭！」船隊順流而回。諸葛亮如期交箭，周瑜聽了，長長地嘆了一口氣：「我真的比不上他啊。」
